title: Long Beach, CA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Long Beach, CA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Long Beach is a city in CA with a population of 466,742. Port city with waterfront, diversity, and a more relaxed vibe than LA. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 10b growing zone supports Hot — tropical and subtropical crops, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 278 sunny days a year.
